scope: Mycelink plugin (hooks, fence, controller, state, TDD, reviewer) and the public-project benchmark harness; six public PRDs; model-free only

classification.HARD_SAFETY: ownership, secrets/hidden evaluator, controller/product separation, stale result isolation, resource locks, exact candidate/evidence
classification.EVIDENCE_GATE: an outcome checked at a semantic transition; it does not dictate implementation commands
classification.RECOVERABLE_ADVISORY: an unusual but legitimate situation: logged and reconciled, never a product attempt charged for an orchestration or administrative issue
classification.OVERCONSTRAINT: a command, path or workflow restriction the stated invariant does not need, or a case-specific coupling

worker_may: inspect any file and history, including the base checkout
create helpers and choose its own structure inside owned paths
split tests and add test data or snapshots
write through file tools, heredocs, moves and generators (computed targets in its worktree included)
commit, reset, rebase, cherry-pick and branch its own history
stash push/list/show; pop/apply/drop its own entries
run builds, tests and any local command
write scratch files outside the workspace
run its gates and preview settle (`tdd check`)
judged_by_outcome: ownership of the node delta at settle
fresh verification of the sealed head
the benchmark replay, scope and hygiene
never: Mycelink's state, evidence and scratch area
another worktree's stash entries, stash clear/store
Claude Code transcripts and the provenance ledger
